title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit — remote price
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot debit — Read the same-entity active backup tier standard unit rate as the USD per GB-month remote-protection price reference; absent an active matching backup contract gives zero remote protection price.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot debit — remote price?**

Read the same-entity active backup tier standard unit rate as the USD per GB-month remote-protection price reference; absent an active matching backup contract gives zero remote protection price.

## Contract reference authority

Use the active same-entity managed-backup contract capacity or tier pricing numerically; all resulting records remain compute-managed.
